label: totemo ~ nai
title_raw: とても〜ない ([とても〜ない] )(totemo ~ nai)
title: とても〜ない
meaning: Can`t possibly 無理と言う意味
meaning_example: There is so much (food) that I can`t possibly eat it all

notes.text: This phrase expresses a very strong sense of impossiblity. The verb is usually in the potential form.
notes.html: This phrase expresses a very strong sense of impossiblity. The verb is usually in the potential form.

examples.japanese: たくさんあって､とても食べきれません
examples.body_text:
たくさんあって､とても食べきれません 

		There is so much (food) that I can`t possible eat it all.
examples.body_html:
たくさんあって､とても食べきれません

examples.japanese: 東京ではとても家なんか買えません。
examples.body_text:
東京ではとても家なんか買えません。 

		I can`t possibly buy a house in Tokyo.
examples.body_html:
東京ではとても家なんか買えません。 
I can`t possibly buy a house in Tokyo.
